title: PIVOT: Physics-Grounded Verification for AI-Generated Audio-Video Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.15562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As generative models continue to advance, AI-generated content (AIGC) is becoming increasingly realistic, weakening the artifact cues commonly exploited by existing detectors. Nevertheless, faithfully reproducing the physical behavior of real-world events remains challenging for current generators. We therefore explore detecting AIGC by assessing whether the depicted event satisfies measurable constraints derived from physical laws. We introduce PIVOT, a physics-grounded AIGC detector, instantiated here for audio-video clips, that estimates physical quantities from video and audio, selects physical laws relevant to each clip, and verifies their measurable constraints. Beyond a real/fake decision, PIVOT returns supporting evidence that records the verification outcome, relevant time window, and supporting quantities for each applicable law. translated_abstract: 随着生成模型的不断进步，AI生成内容（AIGC）正变得越来越逼真，这削弱了现有检测器通常所利用的伪影线索。然而，对于当前的生成器而言，忠实再现真实世界事件的物理行为仍然是一项挑战。因此，我们探索通过评估所描绘的事件是否满足由物理定律推导出的可测量约束来检测AIGC。我们提出了PIVOT，一种基于物理规律的AIGC检测器，本工作将其实例化应用于音视频片段，该检测器从视频和音频中估计物理量，选择与每个片段相关的物理定律，并验证其可测量约束。除了真/假判定之外，PIVOT还返回支持证据，记录验证结果、相关时间窗口以及每条适用定律的支持物理量。尽管本工作在音视频数据上进行了实例化和评估，但该框架原则上可以……
tldr: 提出了一种基于物理规律的AI生成内容检测器PIVOT，通过从音视频中估计物理量并验证物理定律的可测量约束来检测AI生成的音视频，同时提供可解释的验证证据。
en_tdlr: PIVOT is a physics-grounded detector for AI-generated content that identifies fake audio-video clips by estimating physical quantities and verifying measurable constraints derived from physical laws, while providing interpretable verification evidence.
